lessons.title: 1. List Creation, Indexing, and `len()`
lessons.description: Lists store an ordered collection of items: `[1, 2, 3]`. Access items with `lst[0]`, `lst[-1]`, and get list count with `len(lst)` and `sum(lst)`.
learning_objectives: Create lists, access elements by index, and sum totals

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — 3.1.3. Lists — Introduction (indexing, len, sum)

lessons.title: 2. List Concatenation & Membership (`in`)
lessons.description: Join two lists with `+`. Check if an item exists in a list with `item in lst`.
learning_objectives: Combine lists with + and check membership with in

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — 3.1.3. Lists — Introduction (concatenation, membership)

lessons.title: 3. Card Games (Concept Challenge)
lessons.description: Track playing cards and calculate hand statistics using lists.
learning_objectives: Use sum() and len() to calculate averages
